paperTitleZh: 物理 全新模擬卷 — 卷二 選修 C 能量和能源的使用（結構題）

parts.label: a
parts.questionTextZh:
一個家庭每日需要把 $150\ \text{kg}$ 的水由 $20\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$ 加熱至 $40\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$。圖 2.3 顯示兩種方法的能量流程：(甲) 用燃煤發電廠的電力推動電熱水爐；(乙) 用煤氣熱水爐。各環節的效率如圖所示。水的比熱容量為 $4200\ \text{J kg}^{-1}\ ^{\circ}\text{C}^{-1}$。
解釋為何燃煤發電廠的效率遠低於 100%。
parts.questionTextEn:
A family needs to heat $150\ \text{kg}$ of water from $20\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$ to $40\ ^{\circ}\text{C}$ every day. Figure 2.3 shows the energy flow for two methods: (I) an electric water heater using electricity from a coal-fired power station; (II) a town-gas water heater. The efficiencies of the stages are shown in the figure. The specific heat capacity of water is $4200\ \text{J kg}^{-1}\ ^{\circ}\text{C}^{-1}$.
Explain why the efficiency of a coal-fired power station is far below 100%.

parts.label: b(i)
parts.questionTextZh: 求方法 (甲) 的整體效率，以及每日所需燃料的化學能。
parts.questionTextEn: Find the overall efficiency of method (I) and the chemical energy of the fuel needed per day.

parts.label: b(ii)
parts.questionTextZh: 求方法 (乙) 每日所需煤氣的化學能，並指出哪種方法消耗較少一次能源。（不計製造煤氣的損耗）
parts.questionTextEn: Find the chemical energy of town gas needed per day for method (II), and state which method uses less primary energy. (Ignore losses in producing town gas.)

parts.label: b(iii)
parts.questionTextZh: 寫出一個即使如此仍可能選用電熱水爐的理由。
parts.questionTextEn: Give one reason why an electric water heater might still be chosen.

parts.label: c
parts.questionTextZh: 若方法 (甲) 改用性能係數為 $3.5$ 的熱泵熱水爐（電力來源不變），判斷它會否比方法 (乙) 消耗更少一次能源。（不計製造煤氣的損耗）試以計算支持你的答案。
parts.questionTextEn: If method (I) uses instead a heat-pump water heater of coefficient of performance $3.5$ (same electricity supply), determine whether it uses less primary energy than method (II). (Ignore losses in producing town gas.) Support your answer with calculation.
